title: The new shopping centre
instructions: Can şehirdeki yeni alışveriş merkezini anlatıyor. İyi ve kötü yanlara dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: A new shopping centre opened in my town last month.

script.speaker: s
script.text: It has more than a hundred shops, a cinema and lots of restaurants.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I went there on the first weekend, but it was so crowded that I left after an hour.

script.speaker: s
script.text: Parking is also expensive: four pounds an hour.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I think I'll go on a weekday next time.

questions.prompt: When did the shopping centre open?
questions.evidence: A new shopping centre opened in my town last month.

questions.prompt: Why did Can leave after an hour?
questions.evidence: it was so crowded that I left after an hour.
